name: Sushi
body:
Station and Complexity poissonier 2

Flavor Profiles umami, texture
Additional Ingredients any

EFFECT

Duration 1 hour/level; Serving Size 1d4+1

DESCRIPTION

Sushi takes sashimi, wraps it in nori and rice to form a roll, then cuts it into bites.

This meal functions like sashimi, except you can combine up to 2 different types of fish and grant the appropriate ranks to 2 skills for the duration. If you only have one type of fish to provide, it grants the second set of skill ranks to a random Knowledge skill instead.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1.
